title: Fix browser CDP readiness and macOS CLI alias auditing after fleet-safe 0.2.235.
changes: Reject ineligible CDP targets when reporting browser readiness and classify configured unavailable endpoints without weakening loopback, origin or authorization controls.
Count a CLI installation alias only when the final entrypoint is a symlink; a symlinked ancestor such as macOS /var to /private/var does not imply a second install.
Preserve published 0.2.235 fleet-safe staggering, backend settling, Redis fencing, device revocation and WebRTC production opt-in protections.
Add browser and CLI regression tests without new MCP tools, expanded device permissions, automatic cleanup or unsolicited screen capture.
Release only after required protected CI, native platform QA, source provenance and public/npm parity gates.
